Problem Statement:
Aleena is playing chess. She wants to create a program for the game of chess as she is a programmer. She creates an 8x8 matrix with the positions of all the pieces. For testing purpose, she places a white bishop on an arbitrary location and a black pawn on another arbitrary location. Determine if the bishop will cut the pawn in its next move. 
Input Description:
Locations of the bishop followed by location of the pawn. 
Output Description:
yes, if it will cut. no, otherwise. 
Sample Input:
0 1
3 4 
Sample Output:
yes 
Explanation:
The location of the pawn is diagonally across from the bishop. Thus the bishop will cut the pawn.
